description: Permanently deletes one asset explicitly selected by the user: a Strategy, or a file in the organisation's vault. Requires write consent. A Strategy requires Strategy management rights. A vault file requires vault access; members who see only their own vault files can delete only those. Deleting a vault file removes it and its stored copy from Lightbringer and cannot be undone; vault folders cannot be deleted here. Does not delete other asset types or withdraw patent-service requests.
